requirements.title: Business Brochures
requirements.definition: Create the requested set of business brochure artifacts.

requirements.boundary_note: Covers pitch-oriented copy and visual content; portfolio and brochure artifact design are separately requested deliverables.

requirements.boundary_note: Social-media content is independently requested from portfolios, brochures, and pitch content; the intended platform remains unresolved rather than defining separate platform Requirements.
